properties.name: The Blue Wolf and the Fallow Doe
properties.summary: The Mongol people descended from Börte Chino (Blue Wolf) who mated with Gua Maral (Fallow Doe) after crossing the sea. Their offspring populated the steppe and eventually produced Genghis Khan, who united the Mongol tribes under Eternal Blue Heaven's mandate. The wolf remains a sacred ancestor symbol.

properties.name: Creation by Eternal Blue Heaven
properties.summary: Eternal Blue Heaven (Möngke Tengri) created the world from primordial waters. He sent a duck to dive for mud from the ocean floor; from this mud he shaped the earth. The devil figure Erlik created mountains and swamps as obstacles. Tengri breathed soul into humans, while Erlik gave them disease and death.

properties.name: The Shaman's Journey to the Sky
properties.summary: Mongolian shamans enter ecstatic trance, their soul traveling up the World Tree or riding spirit horses to reach the sky realms. They pass through nine or thirteen heavens to petition Tengri for healing, rain, or guidance. The shaman's drum is their spirit horse, and their costume represents the cosmos.

properties.name: Epic of King Gesar
properties.summary: King Gesar was sent from heaven to combat the demons infecting the human world. He was born miraculously, endured exile, and united the fractured tribes of Ling. Through martial prowess and divine wisdom, he defeated demon kings in all four directions. The longest epic in world literature — over a million verses in some versions.
